messages.author: 62567b17e8af7868
messages.subject: RRO not detecting MKL
parts:
I've tried installing RRO 3.2.3 along with the MKL on two Ubuntu 14.04 LTS machines and have the same problem - when I start R I get the following message:

No performance acceleration libraries were detected. To take advantage of
the available processing power, also install MKL for MRO 3.2.3. Visit
http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=698301 for more details.
I did not alter the default installation destination on the R installation, so I am not sure what I am doing wrong. Has anyone else had this problem?

messages.author: 02b330b00bfe02d1
messages.subject: Re: RRO not detecting MKL
parts:
I did have the same issue and it was related to the user installing MRO being different to the one installing it. Maybe that gives you a hint.

Also, could you post the contents of your log file mkl_log.txt, please? Are there any error messages in there?

/Daniel
